title: Uniform local lifting from a finite free open-site stalk
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open of $X$, and $x\in U$. Write $T$ for the open module stalk functor at $x$ on the slice site over $U$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor], and $R_{WU}$ for restriction from $U$ to $W$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. There is a family of natural isomorphisms $e_W:R_{WU}\circ S_W\cong T$ (in functor order) for every $x\in W\subseteq U$, chosen independently of any source, target or map. For every integer $m\geq0$, let $F=\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}$ be the finite free module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. For every module sheaf $N$ on $U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and every stalk-linear map $t:T(F)\to T(N)$, there is an open $x\in V\subseteq U$ such that for every $x\in W\subseteq V$ there is a morphism $g:R_{WU}(F)\to R_{WU}(N)$ whose stalk satisfies $S_W(g)=e_{W,F}\,t\,e_{W,N}^{-1}$ in categorical composition order. No affineness, finiteness of $N$, complex, or degree family is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the slice site over U with the open subscheme U. For each W inside U, the linear restriction-stalk components send section germs to their ambient germs. Their underlying additive maps agree, on all generating germs, with the isomorphism given by the final neighbourhood functor (Mathlib Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso). Thus they are invertible. Applying a module morphism before or after the comparison gives the same germ, so they are natural. Transport scalars through the open-immersion stalk-ring isomorphisms and the slice-site equivalences to obtain e_W, independently of F,N,t.

Pass the source F and target N to module sheaves on U.toScheme. The slice equivalence preserves the finite free sheaf, and restriction of stalk scalars along the open immersion is an equivalence. Transport t to this stalk ring. Apply finite-free local stalk-map lifting with the identity source map (and the unit/free equivalences), obtaining a local morphism on a neighbourhood V of x and its germ formula on every smaller open.

For any W inside V, restrict the resulting local morphism and transport it back through the slice equivalence. Every source germ is represented on a smaller neighbourhood inside W. The lift formula on that representative and the comparison germ formula from step 1 imply e_{W,F} followed by t equals S_W(g) followed by e_{W,N}. Compose with the inverse comparison to get the asserted equality. If m=0 use V=U and the unique zero-source morphism; no target finiteness is needed.

theorem exists_open_stalk_free_map_local_lifts
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hxW : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U),
      SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hWU) ⋙
        openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩ ≅ openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩,
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (t : (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).obj
          (SheafOfModules.free
            (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m))) ⟶
          (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).obj N),
        ∃ (V : X.Opens) (_hxV : x ∈ V) (_hVU : V ≤ U),
          ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hxW : x ∈ W) (_hWV : W ≤ V) (hWU : W ≤ U),
            let R := SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
              (homOfLE hWU)
            ∃ g : R.obj (SheafOfModules.free
                (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m))) ⟶
                R.obj N,
              (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).map g =
                (e W hxW hWU).hom.app _ ≫ t ≫ (e W hxW hWU).inv.app N
